name: The Stig
description: Signed — though nobody saw him do it, and the ink tests as tyre rubber. Some say it isn't a signature at all, just a lap time.
creator: bnuuy

bonuses.description: +3% to every stat — every car, every track, every time
+3 handling in anything front-wheel drive — the Reasonably Priced Car years
-3% 0-60 in anything rear-wheel drive — some say he has never met traction control
+3 mra in anything 4WD — some say all four wheels are simply afraid of him
+6 handling and +4 mra at the Top Gear Test Track — his lap board, his rules
+8% payout. Some say he has never once asked what the money is for
